evals.prompt: Lakukan riset teknis mendalam tentang pilihan arsitektur local-first RAG untuk Xninetzy. Buat laporan Markdown, source matrix, claim-evidence ledger, diagram arsitektur, implementation plan, dan validation report di repository. Cari juga bukti yang menentang pilihan awal.
evals.expected_output: Selects technical plus implementation research, audits tools and repository, creates bounded workspace artifacts, verifies primary technical sources, separates proposals from results, and completes citation and adversarial review.

evals.prompt: Tolong review evidence terbaru tentang keamanan dan efektivitas intervensi kesehatan ini untuk bahan policy brief. Saya butuh sumber resmi, systematic review, conflicting evidence, dan batasan yang jelas, bukan diagnosis pribadi.
evals.expected_output: Selects high-stakes health plus policy research, prioritizes current authoritative evidence, avoids diagnosis, records uncertainty and conflicts, and requires professional validation where evidence is insufficient.
Does not invoke the full research project workflow for a single stable fact.

evals.prompt: Baca PDF yang saya lampirkan lalu ringkas bagian metode saja, tanpa mencari sumber lain.
evals.expected_output: Uses the document or PDF workflow rather than research unless the user later requests cross-source verification or synthesis.
